# ANOMAL Guide - Independent Fan Guide

> Comprehensive guide and wiki for the "ANOMAL" puzzle game by Alexis Roumier. An unofficial fan-made resource covering all cases, eras, clues, timeline reconstruction and game mechanics.

## What is ANOMAL?

ANOMAL is a time-travel puzzle game by French indie developer Alexis Roumier. Players investigate four impossible deaths across four different eras — a mountaineer burnt in untouched snow, a conquistador dead with no wound, an astronaut erased in a sealed station, and a figure petrified on an ancient throne. There is no combat, no timer, and no fail state. The core loop is: observe the frozen 3D diorama → collect clues → cross-reference evidence across eras → reconstruct the timeline to solve each impossible death.

**Key Facts:**
- Developer: Alexis Roumier (French indie developer, self-published)
- Platform: Windows (Steam)
- Release: TBA (game has not been released yet)
- Content: 4 cases, 4 eras, 12 clues, 1 anomaly
- Languages: English, French
- Features: Single-player, Family Sharing
- Style: Retro-futuristic CRT terminal aesthetic (phosphor green, scan lines, glitch effects)
- Steam page: [ANOMAL Game Info](https://anomalydetected.fun/game)

**Core Mechanics:**
- Observe frozen 3D dioramas from every angle
- Collect physical, temporal, and supernatural clues
- Cross-reference evidence across four different eras
- Reconstruct the timeline to solve each impossible death
- All four cases connect through a single anomaly

Content: 4 cases, 8 timeline events, 4 eras, 10 achievements

### Cases & Investigation
- [**All Cases (4)**](https://anomalydetected.fun/cases) — The four impossible death puzzles: Frozen Flame, Conquistador's Grave, Void Drifter, Stone Oracle
  - [The Frozen Flame](https://anomalydetected.fun/cases/frozen-flame) — Mountaineer burnt in undisturbed snow (Frozen Heights era)
  - [The Conquistador's Grave](https://anomalydetected.fun/cases/jungle-conquistador) — Conquistador dead with no wound (Emerald Canopy era)
  - [The Void Drifter](https://anomalydetected.fun/cases/void-drifter) — Astronaut erased from sealed station (Orbital Station era)
  - [The Stone Oracle](https://anomalydetected.fun/cases/stone-oracle) — Figure petrified on ancient throne (Buried Temple era)
- [**Cases Walkthrough**](https://anomalydetected.fun/guides/cases-walkthrough) — Complete solutions for all four cases with step-by-step clue analysis

### Eras
- [**All Eras (4)**](https://anomalydetected.fun/eras) — The four time periods: Frozen Heights, Emerald Canopy, Orbital Station, Buried Temple
  - [Frozen Heights](https://anomalydetected.fun/eras/frozen-heights) — 1980s Soviet mountain research station
  - [Emerald Canopy](https://anomalydetected.fun/eras/emerald-canopy) — Jungle with ancient trees and conquistador-era mysteries
  - [Orbital Station](https://anomalydetected.fun/eras/orbital-station) — Derelict space station in the far future
  - [Buried Temple](https://anomalydetected.fun/eras/buried-temple) — Ancient underground temple existing outside normal time

### Clues
- [**All Clues**](https://anomalydetected.fun/clues) — Every collectible clue organized by type: physical, temporal, supernatural
  - Frozen Heights clues: charred compass, station logbook, scorch marks in snow
  - Emerald Canopy clues: intact armor, phantom water, ancient tree carvings
  - Orbital Station clues: suit integrity report, frozen chronometer, viewport residue
  - Buried Temple clues: unknown petrified stone, fresh offerings, prophetic murals
